name: Motorized Roller Shades, 100% Blackout, Gentle Sage

images.caption: Two motorized roller shades in textured gray-green fabric installed on large windows (main)

notes: Skipped for now, 2026-11-08 (Andrew: "motorized is too much for now, let's skip, but record findings."): the configuration below stays as the findings, nothing was added to the cart, and Maddie's plans carry no window treatment until one is picked. CONFIGURED 2026-11-08 in Amazon's Customize now panel, on Andrew's word ("drive the 'customize now' widget"; "the inside of the window is 46.5" (with may a tinnnny bit of space left)"), not added to the cart: Mount Type Inside window frame; Width 46 + 1/2" (+$78.00); Height 50 + 0/0" (+$50.00); "Please confirm the dimensions": 46 1/2" W x 50" H; Motor Type Standard Battery Motor; Remote 1-Channels Remote (+$8.99: the panel says "At least one remote controller is needed for the initial setup of each kind of motor", and None is the default); Solar Panel None; Valance No Valance; Bottom Rod Standard Bottom Rod; Light Blockers None (the panel recommends Light Blockers-White, +$35.99, for inside mounts "to avoid the situation of light leakage on the sides": Andrew's call); Roll position Standard Roll; Motor Side Right Side (the side away from the room's top corner, so the charging port is easier to reach; flip if the window sits otherwise); Extended Maintenance Free 2-year assurance; Contact Information left blank (optional, asks for a phone or email). The panel's rules: "Order Width (Please submit the exact width) ... No need to consider deduction of size, we will make reasonable adjustments based on your width"; "Order Height (Please submit the exact height) ... includes the height of the valance and bottom rod"; "Window Depth >= 2.45"" (the recess is 3 3/4"). Price as configured $256.98 ($119.99 base), before the page's "$40 off coupon applied" and "Save 18% at checkout", whose final effect shows only at checkout; FREE delivery Nov 20 - 25; the product page says "This item is non-returnable" (made to order). Recommended 2026-11-08 for Maddie's room (Andrew: "no print is okay for now, let's be practical. recommend a good color."): Gentle Sage, a soft gray-green that hides small fingerprints better than white, sits with her room's white, green and flowered things and the blue-gray rug (F-68 (3)), calms the honey-orange wood of the window frame instead of spotlighting it, and stays right as she grows. Flags: no-dimensions (F-11: made to order; the overview's 8"L x 3"W is not the shade), assumed-position:window. Staged in every Maddie's room plan: a plain color with the forest in it, F-68 (5)'s soft gray-green beside her white, green and flowered room (F-68 (3)). Andrew, 2026-11-08: "Instead of regular curtains, I'm thinking about doing a auto / remote controled blind setup in the inset of the window (pretty deep ,about 3 3/4" inset. that way I can setup a remote that maddie can use to control it." and "any way to get design prints? I want default colors too, but wondering if I can do something jungle /forest themed". The recess: 46.5" wide, 50" tall, 3 3/4" deep (F-43; measurements.md). IKEA US sold no motorized blind on 2026-11-08 (FYRTUR, KADRILJ, PRAKTLYSING and TREDANSEN searched, none listed), and Andrew prefers Amazon for this purchase. Made to order: the size, the mount, the motor and the remote are set in the listing's configurator behind Amazon's "Customize now", which asks the buyer to accept the seller's terms, so the agent did not open it (F-10): order inside mount at the recess's narrowest width (tape top, middle and bottom to the 1/8"), 50" drop, and check there that the remote is in the order and that the headrail fits a 3 3/4" recess. The listing: "Standard motors support remote control. Pair any motor with our Smart Hub to manage all your electric shades with any version of Alexa or Google Assistant", a Matter over Thread motor offered, Solar/USB charging (title). Cordless: no cord for Maddie to reach (F-21). Overview rows: Material Blackout; Product Dimensions 8"L x 3"W (not the shade: it is cut to order); Brand WEFFORT; Opacity Blackout. Price: $119.99 is the listing's starting price before the configurator; the price for 46.5 x 50 was not read. 4.8 stars (538). Delivery: FREE November 20 - 25 (custom). Colors on the listing include Gentle White, Gentle Sage, Gentle Dove, Gentle Pale Grey, Gentle Wheat, Classic White/Cream/Grey, Linen White/Stone/Caramel, Texture White/Cream/Smoke and darker ones. rooms: maddie-room, from the brief.
